definitions.gloss: high quality; superior quality; fine grade
definitions.explanation: Describes something of notably good quality, especially materials, products, or ingredients. Often used as a noun modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {上質|じょうしつ}な{紙|かみ}を{使|つか}う。
この{革|かわ}は{上質|じょうしつ}で{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: This leather is high quality and lasts a long time.

examples.japanese: {上質|じょうしつ}な{素材|そざい}を{厳選|げんせん}して{作|つく}られたバッグです。
examples.english: This is a bag made from carefully selected high-quality materials.

notes:
Describes superior quality of materials, products, or craftsmanship. Composed of {上|じょう} (upper/superior) + {質|しつ} (quality). Used as a noun modifier with な or の.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上質|じょうしつ}な{紙|かみ}: high-quality paper
- {上質|じょうしつ}な{素材|そざい}: fine materials
- {上質|じょうしつ}な{革|かわ}: high-grade leather
- {上質|じょうしつ}な{睡眠|すいみん}: quality sleep

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}: high quality — more technical, often used for manufactured products and standards
- {良質|りょうしつ}: good quality — slightly broader, also used for abstract things like education or information
- {高級|こうきゅう}: high-class, luxury — emphasizes prestige and price rather than material quality
